name: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd
title: Stallion India Fluorochemicals Ltd - 544342 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Management targets 30–35% revenue CAGR and FY27 PAT ~INR 100 cr off a 10,000 t R-32 plant (Oct-26 start), but Q4 top line was flat at ~INR 110 cr and the quota is unannounced; treat as promise-heavy, not yet proven.

capex.peers_comment: Other companies' R-32 capacity of about 25,000 to 50,000 tons is coming up; management says the Indian market is about 20,000 to 22,000 tons.
capex.quote: there are other capacities that are coming up about 25,000, 30,000, 40,000 about 40,000 to 50,000 tons extra capacities are coming up

triggers.label: Peer R-32 capacity 40-50k t coming
triggers.quote: about 40,000 to 50,000 tons extra capacities are coming up

triggers.label: Mkt ~20-22k t vs new capacity
triggers.quote: the Indian market per se is 22,000 20,000 tons market

triggers.label: R-32 price 800-900/kg vs 500 assumed
triggers.quote: between 800 and 900 is what the pricing is currently of 32

triggers.label: Q4 revenue flat ~INR 110 cr
triggers.quote: INR 110 CR, 106 CR, 105 CR and in the last current quarter Q4 INR 110 CR

triggers.label: 2030 target INR 3,000 cr revenue
triggers.quote: our target figures are by 2030 we want to have INR 3,000 crore revenue and we want to have a PAT of INR 500 crore

guidance.quote: we continue to target a revenue growth CAGR of 30 to 35% over the next three years
our PAT numbers should be about INR 100 crores
is expected to commence production by October 26

guidance.value: INR 3,000 crore revenue, INR 500 crore PAT
guidance.quote: our target figures are by 2030 we want to have INR 3,000 crore revenue and we want to have a PAT of INR 500 crore

prior_guidance_check.metric: FY26 revenue INR 430 cr and PAT INR 40 cr
prior_guidance_check.quote: we had put our target internally at INR 430 crores and INR 40 crore PAT which we have surpassed

prior_guidance_check.metric: Revenue of INR 675 cr this year
prior_guidance_check.quote: INR 430 crores and 30% is INR 559 crores

red_flags.label: Equity dilution at INR 99 vs 140 target, holding cut
red_flags.quote: we had to open it at 99 and that dilution resulted in the fall of the shareholding

red_flags.label: Promoter sold rights entitlement, dispute on rights application
red_flags.quote: we can see that you sold your rights entitlement to alternate investment fund, a DII, about 16% of your holdings

red_flags.label: Flat Q4 revenue despite price rise
red_flags.quote: the top line is almost flat from last three four quarters

red_flags.label: Exited 4,500 t domestic R-32 sales for margins
red_flags.quote: which we we brought down to less than 400-500 tons because the margins currently are so low

red_flags.label: Vague quota allocation basis
red_flags.quote: none of us have privy to that information and none of us can comment on that

evasions.quote: none of us have privy to that information and none of us can comment on that

evasions.topic: Q4 volume decline vs flat revenue

evasions.quote: Have you seen what we have applied? The amount of shares I sold I bought back.
